title: On the arithmetic rank and cohomological dimension of some residual intersections
summary: We determine the arithmetic rank and cohomological dimension of each generic residual intersection of the ideal of submaximal Pfaffians of an alternating matrix of variables. This ideal fails to be a set-theoretic complete intersection. Our methods yield several structural results: in characteristic zero, we compute the $D$-module length of the top local cohomology module supported at this ideal and show that over the integers, it admits a $\mathbb{Q}$-vector space structure.
